body:
Hello, my dear!

Sam asked me to write: he's been making reading cards for the little ones at the library, but somebody muddled up all the labels!

Would you help put them right? The library is the tall blue building on the high street.
summary: Put the reading cards right in Bellhaven's library.
done: The reading cards are all in order!

tasks.where: at the library in Bellhaven (take the map)
at the coop by your house
